xiaolin_talking_head.signature: speaker returns frequently while evidence, documents, charts, and B-roll carry most visual progress

wizard_explainer.signature: continuous voiceover drives a cinematic evidence chain; visuals replace the speaker as attention anchor

lane_a_talking_head_rules.safe_area_policy: speaker_bottom_or_side_preserved; overlay must not cover face or subtitles

lane_b_explainer_rules.data_policy: reuse article charts/tables or verified data; no schematic chart unless marked schematic

transition_rules.hard_cut: default for talking-head and fast evidence switching
transition_rules.impact_cut: use on hook, objection, contradiction, number shock
transition_rules.push_zoom: use on document, webpage, screenshot, table highlight
transition_rules.data_reveal: use on charts: axis first, mark second, annotation third
transition_rules.path_highlight: use on causal chains and process diagrams
transition_rules.chapter_hit: short sound hit plus title card; no long ornamental transitions

audio_rules.transition_sfx: only for chapter, number shock, document reveal, final CTA
audio_rules.silence_policy: no mid-video dead air; replace pauses with J-cut/L-cut, broll, or music tail

qc_fail_conditions: developer labels visible in final video
fake chart or unsourced number used as evidence
subtitle overlaps with face, chart, or bottom UI
speaker absent for more than 24 seconds in talking-head lane without strong evidence sequence
no evidence scene for more than 40 seconds in explainer lane
scene longer than 12 seconds with no motion or focus change
more than two visual systems mixed in one video without deliberate chapter reset
